info.title: Urja Meter Operations API
info.description: Production-minded RESTful API service wrapping the Urja Meter Operations portal. Provides authenticated proxy endpoints for Distribution Transformers, Smart Meters, Geospatial positions, Interval Consumption telemetry, Network Hierarchy, and HMAC-signed Data Exports.
